title: Compliance resolution fund.
bodyText: Any law to the contrary notwithstanding, fees and fines collected by the commissioner shall be deposited into the compliance resolution fund established pursuant to section 26-9(o).
bodyHtml: [§454M-11]  Compliance resolution fund.  Any law to the contrary notwithstanding, fees and fines collected by the commissioner shall be deposited into the compliance resolution fund established pursuant to section 26-9(o). [L 2009, c 106, pt of §1]
